name: Probabilistic Prediction of Pixel-Aligned Gaussians
definition: A method to predict Gaussian primitive parameters (mean μ, covariance Σ, opacity α, spherical harmonics S) from per-pixel features by predicting a discrete probability distribution over depth buckets and sampling from it, avoiding local minima associated with direct regression.
summary: Probabilistic Prediction of Pixel-Aligned Gaussians predicts 3D Gaussian parameters by modeling depth as a discrete probability distribution over buckets, avoiding local minima inherent in direct regression.
